production_spec.style: Existing clean pixel-art relic set: dark outlines, restrained palette, clear single-object silhouettes, upper-left light. No text, frames, gradients, gore or photorealism.
production_spec.integration: All five relics and their reviewed icons are live after user confirmation.

icons.name: 镀金扳机
icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE inventory relic icon matching the supplied existing pixel-art relic reference. Subject: a detached polished brass-gold curved trigger on a very short dark iron mounting block, with a small deep-violet pivot. Show a large unmistakable curved trigger silhouette, not an entire gun. Match a 32x32 logical pixel grid, clean stepped edges, flat discrete color clusters, dark desaturated outlines and upper-left highlights. Centered single object, about 80 percent of square canvas, generous transparent margin. The artifact should feel tempting and valuable with a subtle uncanny accent. No words, letters, numbers, weapon hand, frame, background scene, soft blur, gradients, gore or extra objects. Final intended use is a 32px game icon; preserve readability at that size.

icons.name: 无眠账簿

icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE inventory relic icon matching the supplied existing pixel-art relic reference. Subject: a small OPEN midnight-indigo accounting ledger with cream pages, a single small wakeful eye embedded across the central fold, and one short dark-red ribbon bookmark. The open-book silhouette must differ clearly from the closed purple compound-interest tome in the reference. Match a 32x32 logical pixel grid, hard stepped edges, discrete flat color clusters, dark outlines and upper-left highlights. Centered isolated single relic, 80 percent of canvas with transparent margins. Clean light eldritch fantasy, attractive and readable rather than gruesome. No readable writing, letters, numbers, border, scene, soft gradients, realistic eye, gore or extra objects.

icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE inventory relic icon matching the supplied existing pixel-art relic reference. Subject: a compact triangular brass mechanical cage holding a cracked violet crystal, with two short iron electrodes at the sides. The triangular machine silhouette must remain obvious at 32px and differ from a plain gemstone. The crystal has only two or three crisp white-violet highlight pixels, no blurred aura. Use a 32x32 logical pixel grid, clean stepped edges, dark outlines, limited palette, upper-left light and generous transparent margins. Single centered object, no writing, labels, numbers, frame, background scene, gradients, gore or extra floating debris.

icons.name: 狂热分红
icons.recommended_effect: 每次成功结息：通用伤害+1%，理智−2；上限1
icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE inventory relic icon matching the supplied existing pixel-art relic reference. Subject: a cream dividend ENVELOPE with a prominent dark-crimson wax seal and exactly two gold coins emerging from its top edge. Keep the folded envelope silhouette, clearly different from the flat written dividend check in the reference. icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE inventory relic icon matching the supplied existing pixel-art relic reference.
